cohort: The study included 183 participants who underwent dinoprostone insert-induced labor at the Department of Obstetrics and Perinatology of the Jagiellonian University Medical College.
finding: The study found no significant difference in perinatal outcomes between anemic and non-anemic groups, suggesting that mild anemia may not significantly affect dinoprostone insert-induced labor outcomes.
mod_finding: The study found no significant difference in the likelihood of cesarean section between anemic and non-anemic groups.
